audit_items.proof_trace: Pre-Fulu epochs skip blob parameter XOR (line 576-577), causing entries with identical ForkVersion but different MaxBlobsPerBlock to produce identical ForkDigests. The byDigest map (line 518) can only store one entry per digest, violating the injective property.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker connects with fork digest matching one pre-Fulu blob config, then sends messages using different blob config that shares same digest. P2P validation using ForkDataFromDigest cannot detect mismatch.
